picks.title: ทส. สั่งเอาผิดเด็ดขาด ลักลอบทิ้งขยะอุตสาหกรรมปนขยะชุมชนชลบุรี ผงะพบสารโลหะหนักอื้อ เร่งสืบหาต้นตอ
picks.memo: Ministry orders PCD to prosecute industrial waste dumped with household waste on 7+ rai in Nong Prue, Bang Lamung (Chonburi); heavy metals antimony, cadmium, lead found; source being traced. Follow-up to 10-28 landfill story with new facts.

picks.title: Phuket City issues red alert as roads flood on October 29
picks.memo: Phuket City red flood alert 07:40 Oct 29 for Bang Yai Canal; Khok Tanot Rd (Karon) closed, small vehicles blocked at 2 Chalong spots.

picks.title: Don Mueang International Airport to introduce manual passenger searches from November 1
picks.memo: Don Mueang Airport switches to manual pat-down searches from Nov 1 replacing handheld metal detectors, under CAAT Regulation No.113.

picks.title: Thailand Scrambles for 15-Day Visa on Arrival Fix
picks.memo: Thai tourism authorities pushing a fast-track 15-day visa on arrival for emerging markets after arrival drop. Policy still under consideration (not yet in force).

picks.title: Thailand Tightens Retirement Visa Insurance Requirements
picks.memo: Immigration officers checking retirement-visa health insurance documents more strictly; baseline insurance rules technically unchanged.

picks.title: French man arrested on Koh Samui over 50 million baht tax fraud case
picks.memo: Immigration police arrested a 53-year-old French man in Bo Phut, Koh Samui on Oct 28 over a French VAT fraud/tax evasion case (~50 million baht losses).

picks.title: ปิดล้อมล่า 5 ชั่วโมง! 4 เมียนมาฆ่านายจ้างจีน ยอมมอบตัว หลังหนีซ่อนป่าอ้อยพนัสนิคม
picks.memo: 4 Myanmar workers who killed their Chinese employer in Lat Krabang surrendered after 100+ officers surrounded a 100-rai sugarcane field in Phanat Nikhom (Chonburi) overnight Oct 28. Follow-up (arrest) to 10-28 pm story.

picks.title: Police arrest 5 in network sending Thai women to Singapore for sex work
picks.memo: CIB held 5 people in Rayong and Phitsanulok over a network sending Thai women to Singapore for sex work since 2019; Singaporean man admitted; tip from Singapore police.

picks.title: China Airlines plane stuck on runway at Suvarnabhumi Airport
picks.memo: China Airlines B737-800 CI840 Bangkok-Kaohsiung got main landing gear sunk into runway surface at Suvarnabhumi on Oct 28 before takeoff.

picks.title: 30 ต.ค. 69! กฟน. ประกาศดับไฟ 9 จุด ในกรุงเทพฯ สมุทรปราการ นนทบุรี
picks.memo: MEA planned power cuts at 9 locations on Fri Oct 30 in Bangkok, Samut Prakan, Nonthaburi.

picks.title: กทม. แจ้งเตือนประชาชน เฝ้าระวังน้ำทะเลหนุนสูง 28 ต.ค. - 5 พ.ย.
picks.memo: BMA warns of high sea tide Oct 28-Nov 5; residents in low areas along Chao Phraya should monitor.

picks.title: กทม. เปิดจุด ‘นัดทิ้ง นัดเก็บ ขยะชิ้นใหญ่ฟรี’ ที่นอน โต๊ะ เก้าอี้ ทิ้งได้หมด
picks.memo: BMA free bulky-waste drop/collection (mattresses, tables, chairs) on Oct 31 and Nov 1; put out before 08:30, collection 09:00-12:00.

picks.title: Thailand weather today, 29 October: heavy rain in 12 provinces, Bangkok showers
picks.memo: Heavy rain forecast in 12 provinces Oct 29, mostly south (Phuket, Krabi, Surat Thani, Songkhla etc.), flash flood risk; Bangkok scattered thundershowers.

picks.title: Golden retriever attack in Rayong believed to be triggered by hunger
picks.memo: Golden retriever bit elderly owner and housekeeper in Huai Pong, Mueang Rayong on Oct 27, both seriously injured; believed hungry/stressed.

picks.title: Five tourists rescued after getting lost in Chon Buri forest
picks.memo: 5 tourists in 2 groups got lost hiking to Khao Tao viewpoint near Huai Luek Reservoir, Bang Lamung on Oct 28 and were rescued.

picks.title: สลิงเครนขาด เสาร่วง ฟาดคนงานเจ็บ
picks.memo: Crane sling snapped 16:30 Oct 28 while lifting an electric pole in Soi Hua Nong Bon 19, Huai Yai (East Pattaya); pole fell and injured a worker.

picks.title: ไฮเออร์ทุ่ม 5,250 ล้านบาท ตั้งโรงงานเครื่องซักผ้าระยอง
picks.memo: Haier invests 5,250 million baht in washing-machine plant at WHA ESIE 5, Rayong; 3 million premium units/year for Thailand, Europe, Middle East, Oceania.

picks.title: สุชาติ ปลื้ม ปะการังหมู่เกาะมัน ระยอง สมบูรณ์ปานกลางถึงดี จับตาตัวอ่อนปะการัง
picks.memo: Survey finds coral reefs at Koh Man islands, Rayong in moderate-to-good condition; monitoring coral larvae and marine debris.

picks.title: ชายแดนแม่สอดระอุ! เมียนมาถล่มกันเดือด กระสุนตกฝั่งไทย ชาวบ้านเจ็บ 1 ราย
picks.memo: Myanmar army shelling at Mae Sot border on Oct 29; rounds landed on Thai side injuring 1 villager; Ratchamanu task force fired warning shots under ROE.

picks.title: มอบตัวแล้ว! 8 คนร่วมตัดต้นนางพญาเสือโคร่งเขตอุทยานดอยสุเทพ ย่องเข้าพบ ตร.ตามหมายเรียก-ปฏิเสธตลอดข้อกล่าวหา
picks.memo: 8 people summoned for cutting Thai sakura (Prunus cerasoides) trees in Doi Suthep-Pui National Park reported to Phu Phing police; denied all charges, released.

picks.title: สุรศักดิ์ รับ 'น้ำท่วมภูเก็ต' กระทบเศรษฐกิจแต่ไม่มาก หวังอีเวนต์ปลายปีดันท่องเที่ยว
picks.memo: Tourism minister Surasak says Phuket floods have limited economic impact, tourists not cancelling; year-end events to boost tourism; 2027 target growth 5-10%.

picks.title: Foreign duo win hearts after helping Thai driver in Phuket
picks.memo: Two foreign men praised online for pushing a Thai motorist's stalled car through floodwater in Rawai, Phuket (TikTok video, Oct 28).

picks.title: Thai beauty blogger accuses Suvarnabhumi Airport officer of attempted assault
picks.memo: Beauty influencer Kotchawan 'Gamgy' Sajja alleges a female AOT employee tried to attack her after a dispute over two water bottles at Suvarnabhumi; allegation only.

picks.title: ตำรวจสากล 100 ประเทศทั่วโลก ประชุมไทย ถกสินค้าปลอม-ภัยดิจิทัล
picks.memo: 19th INTERPOL IP crime conference held in Thailand with 100+ countries, Royal Thai Police with INTERPOL and ULSE; counterfeit goods and digital threats, AI use.
